subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and security-review this bridge as a bundled package, or require the Claude and GLM harnesses to ship as external plugins through the existing plugin ecosystem?
rationale: That choice determines dependency ownership, credential and support boundaries, the permanent plugin API contract, and whether the current core changes belong in this repository.

options.title: Externalize the integration
options.body: Keep the provider bridge outside core and publish the Claude and GLM harnesses as external plugins unless a concrete missing SDK seam is identified.

options.title: Sponsor bundled adoption
options.body: Adopt or republish the bridge under an approved OpenClaw ownership model, define security review responsibilities, and require the branch to use canonical state and public plugin seams.

recommendation.title: Externalize the integration
recommendation.body: Keep the provider bridge outside core and publish the Claude and GLM harnesses as external plugins unless a concrete missing SDK seam is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history connects Eddie to the requested runtime and operator behavior, while final repository sponsorship still needs an explicit maintainer response.
